clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge's Mystic Ward, Braenna Flintcrag guides dwarves in the ways of the Holy Light. She trains priests in healing and spiritual discipline, and tells visiting night elf priests when they are called home to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

Braenna Flintcrag trains priests in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries. From the Mystic Ward, she teaches dwarven acolytes the Holy Light's healing arts and defensive wards, preparing them for a dangerous world. Her work tends the spiritual needs of Khaz Modan, amid a city renowned for its forges and warriors.
